packet.goal: I want to learn how to worship god better
packet.new_task: In an imagined town the music hall has stood empty for months. Write an optional line of lament for a player who misses making music with others. Explain how the line takes its form from this passage. Keeping the exercise private is also a choice.

required_reference.locator: Psalm 13:1, opening question. World English Bible, updated 66-book edition, 2020 stable text, eBible.org (public domain).

response.response:
How long, LORD, before we make music together in the hall again?

The line borrows the opening question, “How long, LORD?” (Psalm 13:1, World English Bible). It keeps the direct address to the LORD and makes the player’s longing specific by asking when the musicians will play together again.
